title: Adapter health
notConnected: Connect to a car (or the simulator) to test the adapter. This times a burst of commands and grades your ELM327.
subtitle: Firmware, voltage, protocol & latency — is my clone junk?
noCommunity: No community reports for this adapter yet — share the JSON to add one.

good.title: Adapter is healthy
good.detail: The OBD adapter answers quickly and reliably, so it is not the cause of dropouts or odd readings.

ok.title: Adapter is usable, with caveats
ok.detail: The OBD adapter works but is not fast, or reports a clone firmware string. Expect occasional quirks; a better adapter may help if readings drop out.

poor.title: Adapter is slow or unreliable
poor.detail: The OBD adapter answers slowly or not at all. Reseat it or try a better adapter before trusting live data or blaming the car.
